queries_run: Fortive business model transition subscription OR platform 2026
Fortive distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述非美國銷售主要由海外子公司，並經代表與經銷商；低銷量國家一般透過代表與經銷商。未揭露通路結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: In countries with low sales volumes, we generally sell through representatives and distributors.

findings.claim: 2026 proxy 稱成長方法含 commercial acceleration 與 recurring customer value；MS 會議摘要稱產品附加服務方案與訂閱軟體。
findings.excerpt: and deliver on our “Fortive Accelerated” strategy of faster profitable growth, disciplined capital allocation and building and maintaining investor trust. In doing so, we have incorporated new technology enablers, like artificial intelligence and machine learning and are building new capabilities to drive accelerated innovation, greater commercial success and more recurring customer value.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未找到通路去中介或D2C的一手來源；2026 Q1-Q3 10-Q僅見經銷商庫存/財務健康的一般風險語言。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
